Meet Archie

Build personal AI agents that run on your own computer, agents you shape, name, and truly own. No terminals, no code, no middleman.

Archie is in testing, Mac and Windows both, and not for sale yet. The waitlist hears the moment that changes.

Join the waitlist
The idea

Your own agent, on your own computer.

Archie is a desktop app that runs your own AI agent. You talk to it the way you’d text a friend, and it gets things done: keeping your calendar straight, staying on top of your inbox, running research, and handling the busywork you’d rather not.

What makes it different is where it lives: on your computer, not on ours. It talks to the AI company directly, on your own account. You own the whole thing.

Building it

Shape it piece by piece.

Archie is modular. Your agent arrives working, asks what your days look like, and fits its own pieces from your answers. Every one of them is yours to swap, remove, or add to.

Personality

How your agent talks to you. Warm and chatty or brief and to the point.

Skills

The things it can do. Add new abilities in a click from the built-in marketplace: calendar management, inbox triage, research on the live web, and more.

Routines

Things it does on its own, on a schedule. A briefing every morning, a report every Friday, without being asked.

Knowledge Base

Give it your files (notes, PDFs, documents) so it answers from what you know, not just what it was trained on.

Connections

Link the tools you already use, like Gmail, Outlook and your calendar, only ever when you say so.

Our servers

What we can see.

Its keys sit in your computer’s built-in password store, where we have no way to read them, and once your own key is connected your conversations never pass through us. The one exception (the starter credits) and every single thing that does leave your computer is listed on the trust page.

What lives on your computer

  • Your agent and everything it knows
  • Your files, notes, and its memory
  • Your connected accounts and API keys
  • Every message you exchange

What Otian can see

  • Your email address, so you can sign in
  • Whether you have a current plan
  • Which paid add-ons you’ve bought
  • Which version of Archie you are running
  • The messages to your phone, sealed, if you turn phone access on
  • Some smaller account records: crash reports if you leave them on, what the free credits spent, a second factor, an invoice. The whole list is on our Trust page
  • Never your chats, files, or accounts, so there is no central copy to breach
No code required

Built for people, not programmers.

Running your own AI agent used to mean terminals and config files. Archie tucks all of that behind a friendly app. If you can send a text, you can run it.

Say hello

This is Ember.

Ember is the face your agents wear. Every agent you make gets its own: a color, a hat, a pair of eyes, dealt from the agent itself, so two agents on one computer never look like twins. Change any of it whenever you like, or hand over a photo of your own instead. Go on, poke him.
